experiment: P43 — Food-safe Jobs allocation and population-growth attribution
interpretation: Diagnostic replay is recorded, but missing authoritative worker-commitment evidence or formula/control qualification prevents an authority claim.

intervention.scope: captured full Jobs planner decision before the existing Jobs executor
intervention.workerCommitmentsEvidence: unavailable from the pinned captured Jobs catalog

wholeRunRelevantSynchronousJobsWorkMs.note: Accumulated captured full Jobs callback time, including native observation, pure planning, and existing executor work; excludes virtual game-time performance.now().

formulaEvidence.farmCapacityFormula: min(Farm count, Farmer count) receives native full-Farm bonus; remaining Farmers are farmhands and retain Farmer impact.
formulaEvidence.fullFarmBonusByAgriculture: 0.65 below Agriculture II; 1.15 from Agriculture II, pinned upstream source.
formulaEvidence.liveMultiplier: Measured Food output = current Food.diff + absolute sum of all native Food consumers; current observed Farmer assignment and Farm formula derive the current effective per-Farmer multiplier.
formulaEvidence.otherSources: All current Food consumer rows are included. An active non-Farmer producer without an independently verified effective-output formula makes the floor unavailable; no source is silently treated as Farmer output.
formulaEvidence.commitmentsAndFormulaLimit: Current commitments are not exposed by the catalog. The explicit empty-commitment test branch is diagnostic only.

caveats: This is a controlled test-only Jobs intervention paired with P42's test-only Construction substitution.
It does not authorize ordinary Jobs overrides, Construction changes, Gather actions, or autonomous success.
A P43 result requiring the unapproved P42 Construction substitution and this Jobs experiment is not an autonomous production success.
Native breakpoints, smartMaximum, and physical maximum remain separate fields in the timeline.
